name: Selixer
summary: Shopify profit dashboard that nets ad spend, COGS, returns and fees out of revenue and reports what you keep per product, campaign and customer, built for fashion and apparel brands.
best_for: Shopify fashion and apparel brands with real ad spend that want profit per SKU and per campaign in one place, and can carry the $299 tier where those features actually live
skip_if: your store is small enough that a spreadsheet still works, you need more than three connected ad accounts without paying $399, or you want a longer public track record than an app launched in May 2026 with one review
honest_knock:
Read the feature lists rather than the prices and the entry tier stops looking like the product. Essence at $149 a month gives you two seats, one connected ad platform, a year of history and an inventory health score. The full True Profit waterfall, the per-product P&L and the POAS and CAC tracking — the reason anyone installs a profit dashboard — all start on Catalyst at $299. So the real price of what this app is sold on is double the headline.

The ad-platform caps decide the tier as much as the features do: one, then two, then three. If you run Meta, Google and TikTok you are on the $399 plan for connectivity alone, whatever your revenue looks like.

The monthly figure is also not the whole bill. Each plan carries an AI credit allowance — 500, 2,000 and 3,000 — and the listing sells top-ups from $25, with usage-based charges billed on the same 30-day cycle. Find out what spends a credit before you budget around the headline.

And this is a new app. It launched on 19 May 2026 and has one public review. There is nothing bad in the record, but there is barely any record, and this is a tool you hand your cost prices, your ad spend and your margins to. Use the 14-day trial to reconcile its numbers against a month you have already closed in your own books before you trust a dashboard you cannot yet audit.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-19 on apps.shopify.com/selixer; unchanged since 10 September 2026) Three tiers, no free plan, each with a 14-day free trial. Essence $149 a month: two user seats, one connected ad platform, a year of historical data, the ad dashboard with campaigns and trends, stockout, overstock and dead-stock views, an inventory health score, 500 AI credits with top-ups from $25, and a site speed analyzer. Catalyst $299 a month adds four seats, two ad platforms and no date cap on history, the full True Profit waterfall, POAS, CAC and product-level ad revenue, per-product P&L and an SKU action matrix, a WhatsApp inbox with AI agent and campaigns, 50,000 emails a month with branded invoices, and 2,000 AI credits. Aether $399 a month adds eight seats, three ad platforms, all nine profit-leak detectors, multi-touch attribution and ad cohorts, demand forecasting and return on inventory, RFM scoring and retention cohorts, automations with 200,000 emails a month, and 3,000 AI credits. The listing publishes no annual rate, so all three are monthly. Charges are billed in USD, and the listing files recurring and usage-based charges together on the same 30-day cycle — the AI credits are the usage part, with top-ups starting at $25. Developer Akaame Export Private Limited; the app launched 19 May 2026 and carries a single App Store review. Two details on the same page as the plans: the entry card is labelled Essance while the Catalyst card's feature list calls the same tier Essence, and the App Store record still shows a single five-star review, from a merchant who had used the app for 15 days.
